name: il-school
description: Read-only Israeli school portal assistant for Mashov (משו״ב) and Webtop (SmartSchool)

interface.longDescription: Read-only assistant for Israeli school portals (Mashov & Webtop). Query lesson timetables, homework with inferred due dates, upcoming exams with linked study material, behavior logs, and inbox messages.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show today's school digest, homework, and upcoming exams for all kids.
